snapshot.results_window: Batch evaluation from 2 October to 23 November 2026; the latest finished attempt per agent and test. Quoted from exam.json leaderboard.note in the site commit above.
snapshot.leaderboard_footer: Questions as of 24 November 2026 · results updated 24 November 2026. Quoted from https://www.embodied-first-exam.ai/leaderboard/ as fetched 2026-11-25 around 9:20 AM PT.
snapshot.rule: Core set only: 481 tasks / 951 tests (416 privileged, 481 standard, 54 realtime). A task is in the core set when tasks.json set is "core". Modes on the board for that task are the letters in its core flag (p, s, t). Overall: a core task counts as solved only if every core mode it has was solved. Standard / Privileged / Realtime: every core test of that mode. Success is the official S mark (verifier reward >= 1 within the token budget). One counted attempt per agent and test. Ranked agents are exam.json leaderboard.shared.runs (11). GPT-6 Luna (codex-gpt6_luna-xhigh) is present in exam.json runs but listed in leaderboard.shared.core_off and is not on the official board; do not rank it.

default_pair.note_on_unsolved: The failure-analysis post, written against ten agents, said 112 Standard tests were solved by no agent and 170 if Astra was removed. This 11-agent snapshot gives 111 and 169. Qwen4 Max is the 11th ranked agent. Do not silently overwrite the post with these counts; show the matrix counts as the live board and mention the post used ten agents.

robodojo_prompt_ablation.also_in_report: https://www.embodied-first-exam.ai/blogs/agentic-robotics-benchmark/ reports the GPT-6 Astra column only (12/54, 33/54, 37/54).
robodojo_prompt_ablation.scope: All 54 RoboDojo tasks in the Standard Setting, not only the 37 core tasks on the leaderboard. Only GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2 are published. GPT-6.2 Astra is not in this table. The official page says scenes, step limits and success checkers stayed the same, and that the leaderboard uses the fully specified prompt. Per-task marks for the three prompts and the RoboDojo harness are not published; show this table as aggregates only and do not invent a per-task prompt matrix.

rows.label: VLA prompt: RoboDojo's one-sentence task description.
RoboDojo agent prompt for GPT-6 Astra: the same sentence plus the task recipe and the return-to-start note from RoboDojo's GPT-6 Astra evaluation.
Fully specified prompt (EFE): the task stated together with every condition RoboDojo's success checker tests, including that both arms end near their start pose. The leaderboard uses this prompt.
RoboDojo agent harness: the agent prompt in RoboDojo's own agent harness instead of Codex or Claude Code; the model sets end-effector targets and RoboDojo's motion planner moves the arms.
